name: Aligned
description: Aligned brings your deal rooms into your AI assistant. Enterprise sellers and their managers can query pipeline, room engagement, stakeholder activity, and mutual action plans in natural language, then build rooms, add sections, and update MAPs without leaving the assistant. Pull a pre-call brief, spot at-risk deals, spin up a room from a template, or add next steps to a plan. Every write is confirmed before it runs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Aligned to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Aligned to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://my.teamaligned.com/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Aligned MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aligned lists 25 MCP tools, including add_map_items, add_section, add_tab, add_tab_from_template, build_room, fetch_brand_assets, get_group_overview, get_map_status, get_pipeline_brief, get_recent_comments, get_room_actions_and_insights, and get_room_brief.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Aligned?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Aligned in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Aligned requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Aligned is developed by Aligned. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
